capabilities: Pull Google Ads and Meta Ads metrics into notes as Markdown tables
Add yesterday's report to the daily note automatically under a chosen heading
Save ads_spend, ads_clicks, ads_conversions, ads_cpa and ads_roas as note properties
Insert live ad-recap blocks that refresh on open with 10-minute caching
Compare against the previous period and flag target CPA with color emoji
extras: Tokens are stored in the vault's .obsidian/plugins/ad-recap/data.json and travel with synced or shared vaults; the Google Sheet option relies on a published CSV link that anyone with the unguessable URL can read. Demo mode works without connecting any account. Roadmap lists Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, breakdowns, weekly/monthly notes and budget pacing alerts.
problem: Obsidian cannot fetch ad platform performance data, so marketers must copy spend, clicks, conversions, CPA and ROAS numbers into notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Google Ads via the official API, or without a developer token through a small Google Ads script
Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) via the Marketing API, with your own choice of conversion actions
so you can chart trends with Bases or Dataview
so you can chart trends with Bases or Dataview

requires.name: Google Sheet filled by scripts/google-ads-to-sheet.js and published as CSV (no-developer-token option)
Google Ads API developer token, OAuth client ID/secret and refresh token
Meta Ads system user token with ads_read permission
Google Ads customer/manager account and Meta ad account IDs

summary: Plugin that pulls Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign metrics into Obsidian notes as Markdown tables, with daily note automation and period comparisons.
